guarantees.file_selection: a local file picker; the product never reaches a console, gateway, or directory
retained_from_a_source: counts per organization unit, day bucket, and model
the derived rubric category of a query, never the query
never_retained: prompt or completion text, including in an error message

attribution.unattributed_row: skipped and counted; never merged into another unit

key_spaces.note: the HRIS org contract's `unit_id`, compared verbatim, never canonicalized
the provider-native project, workspace, or account the bill is grouped by
the department label the export itself carries; grouped as written, never parsed

time_bucket.why: the rubric weights every sampled query once and publishes no time series, so an hour bucket would carry precision no grade can use and would narrow the crowd one row hides in

sampling.selection: the producer's own bounded sample; this contract never asks for a full corpus

partial.situation: the source states it omitted records, or some rows fail validation.
partial.behaviour: accepted; the omitted count and one located issue per skipped row are carried through, and the summary counts what was read rather than what was sent.
partial.never: a partial source is never presented as a complete one.

stale.situation: a delivery arrives at or below the last accepted sequence from the same source.
stale.behaviour: refused whole with `stale_delivery`; sequence decides freshness, never arrival.
stale.never: a re-delivered older snapshot never overwrites a newer one.

malformed.situation: the envelope, the header, or the quoting is unreadable.
malformed.behaviour: refused whole, before a row is read, with the code and the coordinate.
malformed.never: a malformed source is never partly parsed to see what it might have been.

reordered.situation: rows arrive out of day order, or columns in a different position.
reordered.behaviour: kept. Columns are mapped by name; out-of-order rows are counted and reported, because order carries no meaning to a day bucket but a shuffled file is usually an unintended concatenation.
reordered.never: a row is never dropped for its position.

sources.label: Local conversation or audit archive
sources.summary: An assistant's own conversation or admin audit export, already downloaded.

attribution.note: a row with no department is grouped as “(ungrouped)” and counted; a file with no department column at all is incomplete for this purpose and is reported as such

time_bucket.derived: UTC calendar day of the timestamp

provenance.label: Local conversation archive
provenance.detail: Read in this tab. Prompt bodies are measured and discarded inside the parser; no prompt text leaves it.

sources.grades_note: carries no token counts or rubric category, so it places and counts queries rather than grading them; pair it with a gateway log or prompt batch for a literacy grade

sources.label: Gateway or proxy log export
sources.summary: A delimited export from the LLM gateway or proxy the organization already runs.

attribution.note: decided once per file from the caller's grouping unit, never per row from the shape of a cell

provenance.label: Gateway log sample
provenance.detail: Read and classified in this tab. Any excerpt is discarded at the classifier; only the derived category survives.

sources.grades_note: carries the four fields the rubric consumes, so it can drive a graded sample

sources.label: Representative prompt batch
sources.summary: A JSON envelope of already-categorized representative queries, assembled by the organization's own gateway owner.

attribution.note: same key space and same verbatim comparison as the gateway log

provenance.label: Representative prompt batch
provenance.detail: Read in this tab. The envelope declares its own sequence and completeness, so a re-delivery is reconciled rather than summed.

sources.grades_note: the bundled synthetic fixture is one of these, and it grades

unsupported_sources.label: Live gateway or proxy API
unsupported_sources.why: it needs a credential and a network call, and this product makes neither.
unsupported_sources.do_instead: Export a bounded sample from the gateway yourself and choose the file as a gateway or proxy log export.

unsupported_sources.label: Provider admin or usage API
unsupported_sources.why: an admin key would be a production credential held by a page that promises to hold none.
unsupported_sources.do_instead: Download the usage export from the provider console and use the provider-export intake above.

unsupported_sources.label: Live HRIS connector
unsupported_sources.why: a directory connection transfers employee records continuously; this product reads one pseudonymized file the reader chose.
unsupported_sources.do_instead: Use the HRIS org export contract's pseudonymized file, produced on your side.

unsupported_sources.label: Browser or endpoint session capture
unsupported_sources.why: a capture is per-person, per-session evidence, which this contract refuses at any granularity.
unsupported_sources.do_instead: Ask the gateway owner for aggregate rows keyed by organization unit instead.

unsupported_sources.label: Raw prompt or transcript dump
unsupported_sources.why: full prompt bodies are refused whole: the redaction boundary rejects the file rather than reading part of it.
unsupported_sources.do_instead: Ask for categories, or excerpts within the declared excerpt limit, in a representative prompt batch.
